apps.name: Spotube
apps.description: Open-source music player; phone-style app that works with the remote
apps.long_description: Spotube plays music from your own sources through plugins, with playlists, lyrics and a local library. It is built for phones and desktops, so it looks like a phone app on the TV, but the remote can move around it.

apps.name: SimpMusic
apps.description: YouTube Music client; phone-style app that works with the remote
apps.long_description: SimpMusic streams songs, albums and podcasts from YouTube Music without ads. It can show synced lyrics, skip sponsor segments and keep a library on the device. This is the FOSS build for 32-bit ARM, the kind of chip in Fire TV sticks.

apps.name: Metrolist
apps.description: YouTube Music client; phone-style app that works with the remote
apps.long_description: Metrolist is a Material Design client for YouTube Music with playlists, lyrics and offline caching. It is a phone app first, so the layout is tall, but it works with the remote's arrows and Select.

apps.name: RadioDroid
apps.description: Thousands of internet radio stations; phone-style app that works with the remote
apps.long_description: RadioDroid browses the free community directory at radio-browser.info: tens of thousands of stations, searchable by name, country, language or tag. Save favourites, set alarms and record streams.

apps.name: SmartTube
apps.description: YouTube for TV without ads, with SponsorBlock
apps.long_description: SmartTube is an independent YouTube player made for TVs. It has no ads, skips sponsored segments with SponsorBlock, plays up to 8K and HDR where the screen allows, and lets you pick the playback speed. It is not affiliated with Google.

apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.description: The Jellyfin media server's Android TV app
apps.long_description: The official Jellyfin app for Android TV and Fire TV. Sign in to your own Jellyfin server to watch your films, series, music and live TV with a remote-friendly interface. You need a Jellyfin server at home or online.

apps.name: Kodi
apps.description: The open-source media centre
apps.long_description: Kodi is a free media centre that plays video, music and pictures from your drives, network shares and add-ons. It has a ten-foot interface built for remotes, skins to change its look and a large library of add-ons. This is the 32-bit ARM build that suits Fire TV sticks.

apps.name: VLC
apps.description: Plays almost any video or music file
apps.long_description: VLC plays most video and audio files and network streams without extra codecs, including subtitles and multiple audio tracks. It has an Android TV interface, can browse your network shares and plays from USB drives.

apps.name: Moonlight
apps.description: Stream games from your PC (Sunshine or GeForce)
apps.long_description: Moonlight streams games from your gaming PC to the TV, using Sunshine or NVIDIA GameStream on the PC. Pair it once with a PIN, then play with a Bluetooth or USB controller at up to 4K and 120 FPS where the network allows.

apps.name: LocalSend
apps.description: Send files from your phone or computer over Wi-Fi
apps.long_description: LocalSend sends files, photos and text between devices on the same Wi-Fi, with no account and no internet. Install it on your phone or computer too, then pick the TV from the list. Transfers are encrypted.

apps.name: Tailscale
apps.description: Private network to your own devices (about 100 MB)
apps.long_description: Tailscale puts the TV on your own private network (a tailnet), so it can reach your other devices from anywhere, and they can reach it. It is built on WireGuard. You sign in with an existing account; MaterialTV's phone page also works over Tailscale.

apps.name: Hello TV
apps.description: Sample web app: a clock and a remote-friendly grid. Make your own: brick-bread.github.io/MaterialTV/apps
apps.long_description: A tiny sample of a MaterialTV web app: a clock and a grid you move around with the remote. Web apps are web pages with a small manifest; they run full screen and only reach the sites they list. Copy it to make your own.

apps.name: World clocks
apps.description: Plugin: a world-clock widget and row, and a night-blue theme
apps.long_description: An example plugin: a widget with the time difference to a few cities, a row of world clocks on Home and a calm night-blue theme you can apply. Plugins add data, not code. Copy it to make your own.
